entities.summary: Mustapha Ussif is a Ghanaian politician. He is a member of the New Patriotic Party(NPP) and a member of the 8th parliament of the 4th Republic of Ghana representing the Yagaba-Kubori Constituency in the North East Region of Ghana. On 21 January 2021, he was nominated by Nana Akufo-Addo to serve as Minister of Youth and Sports.
